mapper.sql: select crmp_llave as key ,crmp_cuenta as account ,(select ccue_nombre from account.cuenta_cue where ccue_llave = crmp_cuenta) as accountName ,(select ccue_codigo from account.cuenta_cue where ccue_llave = crmp_cuenta) as accountCode ,crmp_periodo as timeFrame ,(select cptm_codigo from account.periodotiempo_ptm where cptm_llave = crmp_periodo) as timeFrameName ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_saldosiguiente as nextBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value ,crmp_estado as state from account.maparesultados_rmp a
mapper.select: update account.maparesultados_rmp set crmp_cuenta = #{account}, crmp_periodo = #{timeFrame}, nrmp_cantidad = #{quantity}, mrmp_saldoanterior = #{lastBalance}, mrmp_saldosiguiente = #{nextBalance}, mrmp_positivo = #{positive}, mrmp_negativo = #{negative}, mrmp_valor = #{value}, crmp_estado =#{state}
